name: obsidian-backup
description: Run the vault data-safety runbook: 3-2-1 backup, the never-deleted originals archive, the schedulers that keep it running, and the restore or new-machine migration procedure. Verifies by reading state rather than trusting exit codes. Triggers: "make a backup", "verify the backup", "the backup looks broken", "restore the vault".
